content.short: Tenderize is a liquid staking protocol enabling users to stake crypto and earn rewards.
content.description: Tenderize, founded in December 2021 by Nico Vergauwen, is a liquid staking protocol that lets users earn staking rewards without locking deposits or actively managing their investment. It enables compounding rewards, swapping tenderTokens for the underlying asset, and earning liquidity farming rewards. When staking, users receive tenderToken, a 1:1 ERC-20 derivative of their deposit that can be traded on DEXs or used in DeFi apps. It currently accepts MATIC, GRT, LPT, and AUDIO deposits, with over 1M in total value locked by September 2022.
